Lead Security Operation Specialist – Emerging Manager •

Led and managed a 20-member team in Mutual Funds trading under Asset & Wealth Management, ensuring high performance and accuracy.

Monitored NAV calculations, P&L posting, trade booking, and reconciliation for



mergers, acquisitions, tenders, and portfolio management. Coordinated cross-location teams (India, US, Manila, Philippines) to distribute workload effectively and meet strict market cutoffs.

Designed and maintained operational trackers, including attendance, leave, volume, error, SLA, and capacity analysis trackers.

Developed and implemented SOPs for all processes across locations, standardizing operations and reducing dependency.

Conducted process walkthroughs, hosted town halls, floor huddles, and team



engagement events to motivate and align teams. Initiated process improvements, enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and SLA compliance across operations.

JP Morgan | Senior Operational Analyst | 2021 – 2023 •

Processed corporate actions and SWIFT payments (MT564, MT566, MT567, MT202, and MT599) across multiple currencies.

Managed trade lifecycle operations, ensuring timely execution and adherence to market and internal policies.

Monitored and resolved internal and external trade breaks, improving settlement accuracy.

Collaborated on process enhancement initiatives, reducing manual effort and streamlining payment workflows.

Utilized BANCS, COSMIC, and TLM systems to execute trade settlements and reconciliations efficiently.

GreatWest Global – Empower | Senior Associate – Money Out | 2019 – 2020 •

Processed client retirement account transactions (401k, 403b, MRDs) via cheques and wire transfers. Investigated and resolved discrepancies or missing information, ensuring timely payment completion.



Ensured compliance with retirement plan policies and client specifications.

Fidelity Investments | Operations Money Out Specialist | 2016 – 2018 • Managed retirement-based payment processing for 401k, 403b, and MRDs. • Verified client requests and processed payments accurately and on schedule. •

Investigated and resolved transaction breaks efficiently, reducing errors and delays.

JP Morgan | Analyst | 2014 – 2016 • Reconciled asset servicing payments, including income and tax payments,

•

ensuring accurate and timely processing. Segregated and processed reports to facilitate efficient payment execution. Identified and resolved internal breaks in TLM; processed SWIFT payments (MT103, MT202) ahead of market cutoffs.

PROJECTS

JP Morgan – Payments & Reconciliation •

Streamlined SWIFT payment processing (MT103 & MT202) by coordinating with agents, reducing dependencies and accelerating payment execution. Identified and resolved application defects in BANCS, ensuring smooth and timely payment transitions.



Automated manual data entry and reconciliation processes in COSMIC, minimizing errors and saving significant processing time.

Wells Fargo – Process Transformation & Transition Management •

Successfully transitioned new processes to India with zero defects, ensuring operational continuity.

Developed and implemented comprehensive SOPs for all processes, reducing team



dependency and standardizing operations. Introduced process improvements and automation to enhance SLA adherence and operational efficiency.

• Designed and maintained operational trackers (error tracking, SLA tracking, volume analysis, capacity tracking) to monitor team and individual performance effectively.
